messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: sev2 - increased text-generation latency and 5xx rate from Embedder fleet (us-west1). Triggered by health-check threshold. Pager: @izzy_oncall, @sam_sre 
izzy_oncall: on it. re-assigning to live mitigate channel, will collect TL;DR and customer impact. tagging @maria_support for customer notifications.
izzy_oncall: initial checks: CPU/GPU utilization normal, but tail latency spikes on embedder v2.3. Stack traces show repeated KV cache misses.
sam_sre: thanks — running quick head logs, pulling trace for the last 10m. command: ```rg "kvcache" /var/log/embedder/*.log | tail -n 200```
maria_support: seeing an increase in error reports from 3 customers (two enterprise, one self-serve). All report timeouts ~10-30s then 5xx. I've opened support tickets and escalated to account teams.
izzy_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) enable degraded routing to embedder-compat (lower perf) 2) increase kvcache TTL on hot shards + restart one replica to warm cache 3) open rollback window for v2.3 if needed. I'll coordinate rollout with @deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: deploy-routing-fallback -> 1779997600 (manual trigger). Rolling update to add embedder-compat route.
sam_sre: quick experiment: bumped kvcache TTL on a single shard -> observed 60% reduction in 503s for that replica. Recommending TTL increase cluster-wide as short-term mitigation.
izzy_oncall: doing TTL bump cluster-wide now on a small batch. Monitoring metrics and error rates.
arya_pm: can we do a quick customer-impact summary for execs? need ETA and whether any SLAs were at risk.
maria_support: summary for execs: ~0.8% API error rate for text-generation in us-west1 region over last 12m, customer-visible timeouts for 3 customers (VIPs). No escalations to legal/compliance yet. SLA blips for 2 customers (monthly latency SLO borderline) — flagging for remediation.
sam_sre: root-cause hypothesis: misaligned kvcache eviction policy after v2.3 change (shard key hashing shift). That caused cold cache storms on hot prefixes. Repro steps in debug logs.
izzy_oncall: agreed on hypothesis. Next steps: short-term (TTL bump + routing fallback) done. Medium-term: patch hashing and canary rollout with tighter telemetry. Long-term: add prefix-aware cache warming.
arya_pm: let's schedule postmortem + action item triage. propose postmortem meeting tomorrow 2026-03-18 10:00 PT. Can everyone make it?
sam_sre: +1 available.
maria_support: available.
izzy_oncall: available.
deploy-bot: Action created: AM-3482 "Increase kvcache TTL cluster-wide (rollbackable)" assignee: izzy_oncall, estimate: 2h, severity: medium.
sam_sre: Action created: AM-3483 "Investigate shard-hash change impact + fix" assignee: sam_sre, estimate: 3d, severity: high.
maria_support: Action created: AM-3484 "Customer outreach + RCA delivery" assignee: maria_support, estimate: 4h, severity: medium.
izzy_oncall: Action created: AM-3485 "Canary patch + telemetry for kvcache hash" assignee: izzy_oncall + sam_sre, estimate: 2d, severity: high.
arya_pm: prioritization: AM-3483 and AM-3485 = P0 for next sprint (ties to Q2 reliability OKR). AM-3482 and AM-3484 = P1, should be closed in current oncall window.
sam_sre: sizing notes: AM-3483 includes code change + integration tests + rollout plan. 3d is conservative. If we find a smaller mitigation we can re-scope.
izzy_oncall: just pushed TTL bump to remaining replicas; errors down ~85% cluster-wide. Rolling back fallback route in 30m if stable.
maria_support: notifying affected customers with interim update and ETA for full RCA after postmortem.
arya_pm: postmortem calendar invite sent to #incident-postmortem and attendees. Agenda: timeline, root cause, remediation plan, action item owners & deadlines. Please add any evidence or dashboards to the doc before the meeting.
izzy_oncall: logging final notes here: mitigation succeeded, customer impact limited to short blip, follow-ups created. Will hand off to remediation owners.
sam_sre: adding log snippets and flame graphs to the postmortem doc.
maria_support: will track customer replies and escalate if any churn risk appears.
izzy_oncall: closing live-mitigation thread; handoff to post-incident remediation queue. Thanks all :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: sev2 -> monitoring. Postmortem scheduled.
